## Cloudmark provides carrier-grade messaging protection and visibility for your greatest asset—your
## end user

We provide the most effective messaging security and compliance solutions to protect your users on
every channel, including mobile messaging, email, rich communications, and social media.

Threat Protection

Defend your #1 threat vector with industry leading protection against spam, SMiShing, phishing,
viruses, and malware across mobile messaging, email, rich communication, and social media. Cloudmark
Platform offers a complete suite of capabilities for mobile operators and email service providers.

Monetization (ROI)

Cloudmark offers a comprehensive range of revenue assurance solutions and capex / opex reductions
designed to maximize return on investment and profit from mobile and email messaging assets.

Compliance

Cloudmark solutions are uniquely positioned to provide complete visibility into messaging traffic
and behavior to ensure compliance with government or corporate regulations and mandates related to
content types, best practices, and sender behavior.

### Explore the Benefits of Working With Cloudmark

Users.

Real-time event webhooks, per channel. email.delivered, sms.failed, voice.completed, whatsapp.read. HMAC-signed. Replay-protected. Same shape every channel. MCP for agents. Connect Claude or Cursor to Bird's hosted MCP server, or run it locally with the bird CLI. Your agent gets typed tools across every channel — scoped keys, full audit, no leakage. ## Five products. ## One shared layer. Email, SMS, voice, WhatsApp, and Realtime — all built on the same primitives. Learn the platform once, ship across every channel. Auth. One key format. Scoped to send vs. manage, read vs. write. Prefix + fingerprint so you know which key did what. Multiple keys live at once, so you rotate on your schedule. Idempotency. Idempotency-Key on every POST, PATCH, and DELETE. Replays come back free and flagged. Reuse a key with a different body and you get a 409, not a surprise. Errors. One envelope. One closed type union. Every code ships with a docs link and a message that tells you what to do. Webhooks. Standard Webhooks spec: HMAC-SHA256, per-endpoint secrets, 5-minute replay window — verify with any off-the-shelf library. Rotate secrets with a 24-hour dual-signing overlap. Attempt logs and replay built in. Pagination. Cursor-based. Stable order on every list, enforced by construction — no page drift, ever. Rate limits. IETF RateLimit headers on every response — not just the 429. You can see your budget before you hit the wall, and Retry-After when you do. Suppressions. Bounces, complaints, unsubscribes — managed automatically, queryable and editable via API. Transactional streams can bypass marketing unsubscribes. Idempotent by design. ## Your messages, actually arriving. Real-time signals on inbox placement, bounce rates, and send volume — across every channel, every region. No guesswork. World's commercial messages, by volume, transit the Bird network. 40% Countries with direct carrier relationships, route diversity, and local compliance handled. 190+ Running this infrastructure. Real-time event webhooks, per channel. email.delivered, sms.failed, voice.completed, whatsapp.read. HMAC-signed. Replay-protected. Same shape every channel. MCP for agents. Connect Claude or Cursor to Bird's hosted MCP server, or run it locally with the bird CLI. Your agent gets typed tools across every channel — scoped keys, full audit, no leakage. ## Five products. ## One shared layer. Email, SMS, voice, WhatsApp, and Realtime — all built on the same primitives. Learn the platform once, ship across every channel. Auth. One key format. Scoped to send vs. manage, read vs. write. Prefix + fingerprint so you know which key did what. Multiple keys live at once, so you rotate on your schedule. Idempotency. Idempotency-Key on every POST, PATCH, and DELETE. Replays come back free and flagged. Reuse a key with a different body and you get a 409, not a surprise. Errors. One envelope. One closed type union. Every code ships with a docs link and a message that tells you what to do. Webhooks. Standard Webhooks spec: HMAC-SHA256, per-endpoint secrets, 5-minute replay window — verify with any off-the-shelf library. Rotate secrets with a 24-hour dual-signing overlap. Attempt logs and replay built in. Pagination. Cursor-based. Stable order on every list, enforced by construction — no page drift, ever. Rate limits. IETF RateLimit headers on every response — not just the 429. You can see your budget before you hit the wall, and Retry-After when you do. Suppressions. Bounces, complaints, unsubscribes — managed automatically, queryable and editable via API. Transactional streams can bypass marketing unsubscribes. Idempotent by design. ## Your messages, actually arriving. Real-time signals on inbox placement, bounce rates, and send volume — across every channel, every region. No guesswork. World's commercial messages, by volume, transit the Bird network. 40% Countries with direct carrier relationships, route diversity, and local compliance handled. 190+ Running this infrastructure. sacrificing security, brands need to offer a seamless user experience. We deliver a fast, efficient,
and secure onboarding experience that builds trust and protects your customers.

With today’s digital experiences, the opportunities for fraud to occur are exponential. It’s no
longer enough to simply rely on a one-time risk assessment to verify customers. Take proactive steps
to “always know your customers” by protecting your business and customers throughout their entire
journey.

[Learn more][75]

## Protection your customers will value

Fraud can happen anywhere on your platform. Through our extensive partner ecosystem and direct
integrations, Telesign plugs into your access management and internal fraud models to improve your
protection against synthetic identity fraud, IRSF attacks, promotion abuse, and more.

[Learn more][76]

## Engagement your customers need

From account verification to purchase confirmation, reliable and secure customer communication is
critical. We deliver complete global voice and text verification and connectivity to ensure you
reach your customers on the channel they trust, no matter where they’re located.

# Advanced Cybersecurity & Management Certification | ACSMI Online Training

The [Advanced Cybersecurity Management Institute (ACSMI)][90] provides professional cybersecurity
certification and management training online. ACSMI is NOT affiliated with the American College of
Sports Medicine (ACSM) — we are a dedicated cybersecurity education organization focused on
multi-domain security training.

Earn your Advanced Cybersecurity & Management Certification (ACSMC) through our CPD-accredited and
ACE college credit-recognized program. Whether you're a [career changer][91], IT professional, or
[aspiring CISO][92], this comprehensive cybersecurity training program delivers the skills employers
demand.

This CPD-accredited and ACE college credit recognized online cybersecurity certification is designed
to bridge the gap between theory and real-world skills. Gain new career opportunities with our
professional cybersecurity certification that provides affordable yet high-quality training across
industries and skillsets to preserve lifetime career success and easier career pivots.

**✔** Led by Janero Washington with 10+ Years of Cybersecurity Teaching Expertise
**✔** Risk-Free 14-Day Refund, Lifetime Access, Flexible Payment Plans & Mentorship
**✔** Real-World Cybersecurity Cases, Labs, Simulations, and Capstone
**✔** Preparation for Certification Exams While Gaining Career Confidence Across Roles

#### Highly reliable & cost effective Telecommunication platform

 Empowering enterprises to seamlessly connect with their clients, BRAMA TEL offers comprehensive
telecommunication services. Utilizing a diverse array of tools including SMS, voice, WhatsApp, and

We provide direct connection with Mobile networks and trusted partners offering customers stable and
secure connection over 180 countries.

Our network is monitored 24×7 by full time in our Network Operations Center, in order to maintain

 Expand your reach and connect globally with our SMS Worldwide Coverage Service. We provide a
comprehensive solution that spans across borders, enabling businesses to communicate effortlessly
with their audience around the world. With reliable and extensive coverage, our service ensures that
your messages are delivered promptly and securely, transcending geographical boundaries. Stay
connected with customers, clients, and partners worldwide, leveraging our SMS coverage service for
seamless and effective communication on a global scale.

#### Voice Service

 We empower businesses to effectively connect with their clients. Our tailored solutions prioritize
seamless communication, allowing enterprises to reach their audience with clarity and reliability.
With a commitment to enhancing business communication, we provide robust voice services that ensure
a reliable and professional connection between businesses and their valued clients.

#### SMS Firewall

 Guarding your messaging infrastructure with robust security, our SMS Firewall Service is a
paramount shield against unauthorized and malicious SMS traffic. We deploy advanced filtering
mechanisms to detect and block fraudulent messages, ensuring the integrity of your communication
channels. With our SMS Firewall Service, your business can confidently safeguard its messaging
ecosystem, prevent spam, and maintain the trust of your users, creating a secure and reliable
environment for SMS interactions.

#### Omni-Channel

 Elevate your customer engagement with our Omni-Channel Service, a seamless solution that integrates
multiple communication channels into a unified platform. Whether through email, SMS, chat, or social
media, our service ensures a cohesive and consistent brand experience across all touchpoints.
Enhance customer satisfaction by providing a versatile and interconnected communication strategy,
allowing your business to effectively reach and connect with your audience on their preferred
channels, fostering a holistic and personalized customer journey.

### Managed Services and Cloud Support FAQ

What types of enterprise services does SMS provide?

As a managed IT service provider, SMS delivers services that cover the ongoing operation, support,
and improvement of enterprise technology environments. This includes infrastructure management,
monitoring, patching, and technical support across cloud infrastructure, on-prem systems, and hybrid
environments.

Managed IT services are structured to maintain system health, meet defined service level agreements,
and support long-term business objectives. The focus is on stability, predictable response time, and
clear visibility into system performance rather than ad hoc troubleshooting.

Why is change control critical in federal IT environments?

Federal IT systems operate under defined requirements for security, availability, and
accountability. Changes to infrastructure, configurations, or access can affect compliance status,
system stability, and mission operations.

Formal change control ensures that updates are reviewed before implementation, risks are understood,
and decisions are documented. It also creates a clear record of what changed, why it changed, and
who approved it. This reduces unintended impact, supports audit and oversight activities, and helps
systems remain stable over long periods of use.

How do federal contract structures affect IT delivery?

Federal IT work is delivered within defined contract vehicles, scopes of work, and reporting
requirements. These structures place clear expectations on how systems are operated and supported
over time. Work must align with approved architectures, documented processes, and agreed service
levels.

As a result, successful delivery depends on consistency and transparency. Decisions are recorded and
changes are tracked in ways that can be reviewed and understood by program leadership, auditors, and
oversight bodies. This structure favors disciplined execution and reduces uncertainty across the
life of a program.

What makes SMS’s managed services different from standard IT support?

Standard IT support often focuses on reactive ticket handling and isolated fixes. SMS’s managed
services are built around ownership and long-term operations.

As a managed service provider (MSP), SMS takes responsibility for how systems are designed,
maintained, and supported over time. Work is guided by documented standards and defined response
times. This approach reduces recurring issues, improves cost-effectiveness, and supports more
reliable decision-making around technology investments.

Can SMS support cloud infrastructure and hybrid environments?

Yes. SMS operates as both a managed IT provider and a managed cloud service provider. Support
includes public cloud, private infrastructure, and hybrid environments where systems span multiple
platforms.

Cloud infrastructure is managed as part of a broader environment, not in isolation. This includes
cloud migration, infrastructure management, remote monitoring, and ongoing optimization aligned to
business goals, security requirements, and cost controls.

What should I expect from enterprise IT services?

Enterprise IT services are designed to support complex environments with multiple systems, users,
and dependencies. This typically includes infrastructure management, enterprise networking,
cybersecurity and compliance oversight, program management, and vendor coordination.

The goal of enterprise IT services is to deliver a consistent level of service across the
organization, improve reliability, and ensure technology supports long-term business objectives
while allowing teams to stay focused on core business functions.

A new class of insiders is emerging. AI agents now act alongside human employees, often at machine
speed and massive scale. Traditional security tools were not built to see or understand this
behavior. To keep pace, security teams need a combination of human
insight and digital-speed intelligence to monitor, govern, and secure this evolving workforce while
simultaneously leveraging its power for accelerated security operations.

About our service

# Buy temporary phone number for OTP

Looking for a fast, reliable way to receive SMS verification codes? Grizzly SMS is exactly what you
need. We help you instantly get temporary phone numbers for OTPs and SMS activation — safe,
affordable, and ready to use.

**Why choose Grizzly SMS?**

We provide a time-saving and budget-friendly service where you can buy a virtual number in just a
couple of clicks. Whether you're a business, a marketer, or just an everyday user, our service helps
you register, verify, and manage accounts with ease.

Unlike many competitors, we don't resell numbers. That means lower prices and higher quality for
you.

## Get phone numbers for SMS verification

The majority of services require a phone number for registration. However, sharing your personal
information may be quite uncomfortable. Don't bother yourself and buy a virtual mobile number for
SMS verification.

Where you can use our numbers:
1. Payment systems & banks: [PayPal][52], [PaySafe Card][53], and more.
2. Social networks: [Google][54], [Twitter][55], [TikTok][56], [Instagram][57].
3. Messengers: [WhatsApp][58], [Telegram][59], [Viber][60].

Our catalog covers almost any service worldwide. Just pick what you need through our easy-to-use
filters and start right away.

After purchase, all SMS codes arrive instantly in your personal panel on our website. You can even
enable notifications so you don't miss a thing.

## Use virtual number to receive SMS anonymously

Your privacy is our top priority. Here's the list of our advantages:
* **Privacy protection.** Unlike some other companies that may share sensitive client data, we never
  do. In fact, we don't even request personal information beyond your email address.
* **No exposure to the online community.** Using your personal number online can lead to unwanted
  calls from scammers or marketers if your data is mishandled.
* **Safety of our clients is our primary concern.** Protecting our clients is our top priority. We
  go the extra mile to safeguard your anonymity and shield you from anything that could compromise
  your privacy, reputation, or finances.

## Temporary phone number for OTP from 100+ countries

Registering on foreign services can sometimes be challenging. In such cases, you may need a
temporary phone number for SMS verification from a specific country.

The SMS activation service Grizzly SMS is fully focused on meeting our customers' needs. You can buy
a temporary OTP number from the [USA][61], [India][62], [Turkey][63] and many other countries around
the world — over 180 countries in total. What is equally important — our prices are affordable,
making it easy to create accounts or profiles on any site that requires phone verification.

## Our benefits

Our mission is to save your time and ensure your safety. Grizzly SMS is designed to solve your
problems quickly, efficiently, and without hassle. We strive to provide excellent service for anyone
who wants to buy a virtual phone number for SMS.

Here are some of the benefits our clients enjoy:
* Affordability for everyone. Prices go as low as $0.04 per number. You'll be satisfied with our
  pricing.
* **Instant delivery.** Numbers are available **immediately** after purchase so you can start your
  operations right away.
* Automated service. All operations are handled by algorithms to minimize human error.
* Effortless convenience. Purchasing and using a number takes just a couple of clicks.
* 24/7 responsive customer support. We value communication and ensure every client feels heard and
  assisted.

Delivering reliable voice and messaging solutions that scale with your business.

[ Contact our team ][21]

Why choose us

### Accessible & affordable communication for all

IDT global is one of the largest global carriers that can deliver the lowest price voice and
messaging solutions at the best quality day in, day out.

### Our Solutions

High quality, competitively priced, flexible communication solutions that can be delivered in a
matter of days.

### Voice

We offer a range of voice termination plans to suit your specific quality and price needs.

[ Learn more ][22]

### A2P Messaging

A2P messaging platform that delivers secure, high‑volume SMS for transactional alerts, OTPs,
promotions, and notifications.

[ Learn more ][23]

### Enterprise SMS

Enterprise SMS platform provides large organizations with carrier-grade infrastructure, global
operator coverage, and intelligent routing to power mission-critical communications.

[ Learn more ][24]

### SMS Firewall

SMS Firewall gives MNOs real-time control over every message on their network, classifying traffic,
blocking bypass routes, and ensuring commercial SMS terminates over the channels that generate
revenue.

[ Learn more ][25]

### Two-way SMS

Enable seamless interactions by allowing customers to respond directly to your messages with their
queries or concerns using our two-way SMS messaging service.

[ Learn more ][26]

### Managed Communication Services

Outsourcing your telecom operations shouldn’t mean losing control, it should mean gaining a smarter,
leaner way to scale.

[ Learn more ][27]

### DIDs

We give you access to a whole range of direct DIDs, local and toll free numbers globally.

markets worldwide.

# Free text

OpenTextingOnline invites you to send free text messages online. That's right, you can text from
your computer to mobile phones using our app. Unlike other free SMS services we offer true
reliability and international reach! No registration, no hassles. The only thing you need is an
internet connection. Love free texting? Enjoy the web app that works!

Please enter the phone number.
-- Mobile service provider (optional) --
picture, video, audio[×][9]

300 KB max.

Send Text
By clicking "Send Text" you agree to [terms and conditions][10].
If you are satisfied with our text messaging service, please spread the word

## How to send texts online
1. Go to opentextingonline.com.
2. Choose a destination country.
3. Enter the phone number.
4. If you wish to receive replies to your text message by email, please enter your email address.
5. Type your text message.
6. Send a text or MMS or both.
7. Wait for reply.
8. Rinse and repeat.

If you are satisfied with our text meassaging service, please spread the word

### Tips
* If you sent MMS (attached image, video, audio) and your message did not reach the destination, try
  to send plain text message instead.
* Save / load conversation feature does not work properly in "incognito" or "private" browser mode.
* For all who are testing the app, don't use words "test" or "testing" - some mobile providers can
  reject it. Text something meaningful!
* If you presented with an option to choose your recipient's mobile service provider, please select
  it. SMS delivery is going to be faster and almost guaranteed.
* If you specified return email and your text message did not reach the destination, try send it
  again without the reply option.
* In some cases it can take some time for a text message to be delivered.
* Some mobile operators may charge the recipient small fees for *receiving* text messages.

Your browser does not support this video (-_-;)
[Full video][11]

### Privacy and security
* If you're worried about privacy, don't. Opentextingonline.com does not sell, trade or rent
  individual personal information to third parties.
* We employ strong security measures to protect the data we collect against unauthorized access.
* We have also put safeguards in place to ensure that users don't abuse our service.
* Spam messages are blocked automatically.
* The IP address of each person who sends texts from the website or by using the mobile app is
  recorded.
* Users who receive unwanted texts from individuals using the service should contact us. We will
  take swift action.

What kind of networking and content delivery solutions does Orient Technologies Limited offer?

Orient Technologies Limited offers a range of networking and content delivery network solutions.

What industries do you cater to?

We provide Cloud services to a wide range of industries, including Pharmaceutical, Healthcare, BFSI,
ITeS, Government-PSU and more.

How can a company prepare for cloud to cloud migration?

A company can prepare for cloud to cloud migration by performing a comprehensive inventory of its
current infrastructure, data, and applications, identifying potential compatibility issues or data
migration challenges, selecting a compatible cloud provider, and developing a migration plan that
includes testing and risk management measures

How can a company ensure data security during cloud to cloud migration?

A company can ensure data security during cloud to cloud migration by using encryption and secure
transfer protocols, implementing access controls and user authentication measures, and performing
regular security audits and risk assessments.

How can Orient Technologies Limited help us migrate our existing applications and data to the cloud?

Our team of experts can assist you with the planning, execution, and testing of your migration to
the cloud. We also offer automated tools and services to help you migrate your applications and data
quickly and efficiently.

What sets your cybersecurity solutions apart from competitors?

Full-spectrum Cybersecurity Solutions - From Cybersecurity Awareness, endpoint security to Cloud
Security and everything in between, Proactive threat intelligence, reducing vulnerabilities before
they escalate, Customizable security layers based on your unique business needs, Strategic
consulting through vCISO services, ensuring leadership-driven security frameworks, Cost-effective
scalability, offering enterprise-level security to businesses of all sizes.

What’s the ROI of investing in cybersecurity with Cyber Solutions?

Businesses that invest in proactive cybersecurity measures reduce breach costs by an average of 70%.

What industries benefit the most from your cybersecurity solutions?

Healthcare (PHI - protecting personal health information), Finance (Aligning with regulatory
compliances; safeguarding critical information assets), Retail & E-commerce (preventing data theft
and securing payment systems), Technology (safeguarding intellectual property), SMBs and enterprises
facing evolving digital threats.

How do your solutions ensure compliance with regulations like GDPR, HIPAA, or PCI DSS?

Our solutions are designed with compliance at their core. We offer frameworks and automated tools to
ensure your security practices align with industry regulations, minimizing risk and preventing
costly breaches.

How do you protect remote workforces and endpoints?

Through advanced Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) solutions, we secure devices across remote
environments.

How do I know which cybersecurity service is right for my business?

We offer a cyber risk assessment and an initial consultation to evaluate your current security
posture.

Can your solutions integrate with our existing security infrastructure?

Yes! Our services are designed to integrate seamlessly with your existing technology stack.

What kind of networking and content delivery solutions does Orient Technologies Limited offer?

Orient Technologies Limited offers a range of networking and content delivery network solutions.

What industries do you cater to?

We provide Cloud services to a wide range of industries, including Pharmaceutical, Healthcare, BFSI,
ITeS, Government-PSU and more.

How can a company prepare for cloud to cloud migration?

A company can prepare for cloud to cloud migration by performing a comprehensive inventory of its
current infrastructure, data, and applications, identifying potential compatibility issues or data
migration challenges, selecting a compatible cloud provider, and developing a migration plan that
includes testing and risk management measures

How can a company ensure data security during cloud to cloud migration?

A company can ensure data security during cloud to cloud migration by using encryption and secure
transfer protocols, implementing access controls and user authentication measures, and performing
regular security audits and risk assessments.

How can Orient Technologies Limited help us migrate our existing applications and data to the cloud?

Our team of experts can assist you with the planning, execution, and testing of your migration to
the cloud. We also offer automated tools and services to help you migrate your applications and data
quickly and efficiently.

What sets your cybersecurity solutions apart from competitors?

Full-spectrum Cybersecurity Solutions - From Cybersecurity Awareness, endpoint security to Cloud
Security and everything in between, Proactive threat intelligence, reducing vulnerabilities before
they escalate, Customizable security layers based on your unique business needs, Strategic
consulting through vCISO services, ensuring leadership-driven security frameworks, Cost-effective
scalability, offering enterprise-level security to businesses of all sizes.

What’s the ROI of investing in cybersecurity with Cyber Solutions?

Businesses that invest in proactive cybersecurity measures reduce breach costs by an average of 70%.

What industries benefit the most from your cybersecurity solutions?

Healthcare (PHI - protecting personal health information), Finance (Aligning with regulatory
compliances; safeguarding critical information assets), Retail & E-commerce (preventing data theft
and securing payment systems), Technology (safeguarding intellectual property), SMBs and enterprises
facing evolving digital threats.

How do your solutions ensure compliance with regulations like GDPR, HIPAA, or PCI DSS?

Our solutions are designed with compliance at their core. We offer frameworks and automated tools to
ensure your security practices align with industry regulations, minimizing risk and preventing
costly breaches.

How do you protect remote workforces and endpoints?

Through advanced Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) solutions, we secure devices across remote
environments.

How do I know which cybersecurity service is right for my business?

We offer a cyber risk assessment and an initial consultation to evaluate your current security
posture.

Can your solutions integrate with our existing security infrastructure?

Yes! Our services are designed to integrate seamlessly with your existing technology stack.

  的业务无国界。SMS-Act 覆盖的国家与 SMS-Activate 相当，但号码质量更高。

  时，提高工作效率。统一价格避免了 SMS-Activate 那样的动态溢价。

* **在线论坛参与**：在保持匿名的同时，积极参与各类在线讨论和社区活动。使用我们[平台][75]的[虚拟号码

重要消息。为注重隐私的用户和需要多种验证渠道的企业提供清晰的[验证解决方案][80]。作为专业的[虚拟号码

## Frequently asked questions

What is a business SMS?
A business SMS is a Short Message Service used for professional communication and remains one of the
most reliable and widely adopted ways to reach customers worldwide. Key advantages include:
SMS works without internet access and is supported by all mobile devices.

• It is a fast, secure channel suitable for use cases such as two-factor authentication.
• Business SMS can be automated and personalized at scale.
• Note: SMS is a text-only format and does not support media content.
How do businesses use SMS?
Companies use SMS for many communication needs, both one-way and two-way.
Typical one-way use cases include sending alerts, reminders, or verifying users via SMS 2FA.
Two-way communication often involves messages that invite a customer response — for example,
feedback requests or confirmation prompts.
How to maximize your ROI with WhatsApp messaging?
Boost your results by sending WhatsApp marketing messages through Broadcasts or Flows in our
customer engagement platform Moments, or via our flexible WhatsApp API.
Examples of effective use cases:

• Personalized offers
• Marketing campaigns
• New product announcements
How to secure and monetize your A2P SMS traffic?
Safeguard your A2P revenue and protect customers from messaging fraud by monitoring real-time
inbound and outbound traffic across both SS7 and SMPP routes.
Use advanced filtering and analytics to detect and stop SIM box abuse. Identify and block SIM farm
traffic while keeping legitimate customer messages unaffected.
What are SMS firewall features?
An SMS firewall provides a set of tools that detect, filter, and control messaging traffic to
protect networks from fraud, spam, and unauthorized A2P routes. Key features typically include
advanced traffic filtering, real-time analytics, policy enforcement, and protection against
grey-route abuse.
How to rotect customers from suspicious and fraudulent attacks
Safeguard your A2P revenue by ensuring all traffic is accurately billed, helping you maximize income
and eliminate grey routes.
Protect customers from SIM box fraud and messaging scams by monitoring inbound and outbound traffic
in real time with advanced filtering and analytics tools.

An SMS firewall provides a set of tools that detect, filter, and control messaging traffic to
protect networks from fraud, spam, and unauthorized A2P routes. Key features typically include
advanced traffic filtering, real-time analytics, policy enforcement, and protection against
grey-route abuse.
How to rotect customers from suspicious and fraudulent attacks
Safeguard your A2P revenue by ensuring all traffic is accurately billed, helping you maximize income
and eliminate grey routes.
Protect customers from SIM box fraud and messaging scams by monitoring inbound and outbound traffic
in real time with advanced filtering and analytics tools.

[Owen McCarthy]

Owen McCarthy

Reviewer

Owen McCarthy has had a long love affair with all things technical since the dawn of the computer
age. A child of the 1960’s, he agrees with legendary author, Douglas Adams, that digital watches
were a pretty neat idea. By the 1980’s Owen was learning how to code using C and by the turn of the
century, he was teaching HTML to enthusiastic youngsters. These days, Owen can be found pestering
editors for new technology to review on an annoyingly regular basis. In his spare time, he rides
motorcycles of the three-wheeled variety, studies theology, aqua-jogs, and works hard to honour his
late wife’s request to live a joy-filled life.

[Sean Mitchell]

Sean Mitchell

Publisher

rest is history.

[Sofiah Nichole Salivio]

conferences and contributing to university publications, honing her skills as a versatile staff
writer. Outside of her engineering labs, you can find her advocating for student voices and looking
for the next great story to tell. She believes that whether you are building a bridge or a news
report, the foundation must be rock solid.

[Tom Richmond]

## Decision Over Chaos

Embracing Agentic AI

Security teams are drowning in alerts while attackers move faster than ever. Securonix Unified
Defense SIEM uses an Agentic Mesh of specialized AI agents to help teams decide and act across the
threat lifecycle with speed, context, and control.
* Unified detection and response across data sources
* AI-driven anomaly detection with context
* Pre-built content and playbooks

**
The Result:** Security teams improve response times by up to 60 percent.


[SEE HOW][162]

## Alerts to Action

Evolving to the Agentic SOC

Traditional SIEMs generate volume. Modern security demands outcomes. As threats grow more complex,
teams need systems that reason, prioritize, and guide response in real time.

Powered by an Agentic Mesh, Securonix coordinates AI agents across detection, investigation, and
response to turn signals into guided decisions with human oversight.

With Securonix:
* Reduce alert noise and surface validated risk
* Accelerate investigations with contextual guidance
* Strengthen breach readiness across the environment
* Elevate SOC Analysts from Level 1 to Level 2

[SEE HOW][163]

## Productivity Instead of Noise

The AI SOC Analyst

Sam, the AI SOC Analyst, operates across the Unified Defense platform, analyzing behavior,
understanding context, and recommending actions across detection, investigation, and response.
Always learning. Always accountable. Always human-guided.

With Sam:
* Automated alert triage and prioritization
* Contextual enrichment using identity, behavior, and threat intelligence
* Investigation summaries that eliminate manual pivoting
* Case preparation for escalation and response
* Executive- and board-ready security summaries


[MEET SAM][164]

## Unified Defense SIEM’s Powerful Features

Securonix unifies analytics, threat intelligence, investigation, and response into a single
cloud-native platform designed for scale, precision, and speed. The Agentic Mesh orchestrates these
capabilities as one coordinated system.

## Threat Intelligence That Drives Action

Threat intelligence only matters when it improves decisions. Securonix transforms intelligence into
operational context by enriching detections, prioritizing risk, and guiding response across your
environment.
* Native intelligence ingestion and enrichment
* MITRE ATT&CK aligned context
* Integrated ThreatQ capabilities

[LEARN MORE][165]

## Less reporting. More investigation.

ThreatQ, now part of Securonix, brings curated threat intelligence into the Securonix security
operations portfolio. It centralizes, enriches, and prioritizes intelligence from internal and
external sources so teams can improve detection quality, accelerate investigations, and respond with
stronger context.

With ThreatQ, teams can:
* Unify threat intelligence across SOC, CTI, and IR workflows
* Enrich and prioritize indicators with relevant context
* Operationalize intelligence across SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, and firewalls
* Strengthen Securonix AI-driven detection and response


[SEE HOW][166]

## Trusted by Global Security Leaders

Evolving to the Agentic SOC

Enterprises and MSSPs rely on Securonix to modernize security operations, reduce operational risk,
and move from reactive response to proactive, intelligence-driven defense. And there’s a reason for
that:

**Six-Time Consecutive Leader in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for SIEM**
Consistently recognized for completeness of vision and ability to execute, reflecting sustained
innovation, architectural strength, and customer trust.

**Two-Time Customers’ Choice on Gartner Peer Insights™**
Validated directly by security practitioners for product capabilities, deployment experience, and
measurable operational value.

Together, these recognitions reflect both strategic leadership and real-world impact for Enterprises
and MSSPs.

[READ THE REPORT][167]

## security services, Securonix adapts to your operating model.

## Decision Over Chaos

Embracing Agentic AI

Security teams are drowning in alerts while attackers move faster than ever. Securonix Unified
Defense SIEM uses an Agentic Mesh of specialized AI agents to help teams decide and act across the
threat lifecycle with speed, context, and control.
* Unified detection and response across data sources
* AI-driven anomaly detection with context
* Pre-built content and playbooks

**
The Result:** Security teams improve response times by up to 60 percent.


[SEE HOW][162]

## Alerts to Action

Evolving to the Agentic SOC

Traditional SIEMs generate volume. Modern security demands outcomes. As threats grow more complex,
teams need systems that reason, prioritize, and guide response in real time.

Powered by an Agentic Mesh, Securonix coordinates AI agents across detection, investigation, and
response to turn signals into guided decisions with human oversight.

With Securonix:
* Reduce alert noise and surface validated risk
* Accelerate investigations with contextual guidance
* Strengthen breach readiness across the environment
* Elevate SOC Analysts from Level 1 to Level 2

[SEE HOW][163]

## Productivity Instead of Noise

The AI SOC Analyst

Sam, the AI SOC Analyst, operates across the Unified Defense platform, analyzing behavior,
understanding context, and recommending actions across detection, investigation, and response.
Always learning. Always accountable. Always human-guided.

With Sam:
* Automated alert triage and prioritization
* Contextual enrichment using identity, behavior, and threat intelligence
* Investigation summaries that eliminate manual pivoting
* Case preparation for escalation and response
* Executive- and board-ready security summaries


[MEET SAM][164]

## Unified Defense SIEM’s Powerful Features

Securonix unifies analytics, threat intelligence, investigation, and response into a single
cloud-native platform designed for scale, precision, and speed. The Agentic Mesh orchestrates these
capabilities as one coordinated system.

## Threat Intelligence That Drives Action

Threat intelligence only matters when it improves decisions. Securonix transforms intelligence into
operational context by enriching detections, prioritizing risk, and guiding response across your
environment.
* Native intelligence ingestion and enrichment
* MITRE ATT&CK aligned context
* Integrated ThreatQ capabilities

[LEARN MORE][165]

## Less reporting. More investigation.

ThreatQ, now part of Securonix, brings curated threat intelligence into the Securonix security
operations portfolio. It centralizes, enriches, and prioritizes intelligence from internal and
external sources so teams can improve detection quality, accelerate investigations, and respond with
stronger context.

With ThreatQ, teams can:
* Unify threat intelligence across SOC, CTI, and IR workflows
* Enrich and prioritize indicators with relevant context
* Operationalize intelligence across SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, and firewalls
* Strengthen Securonix AI-driven detection and response


[SEE HOW][166]

## AI changed everything.

## The AI era demands a new advantage. SentinelOne delivers it.

One platform powered by Autonomous Security Intelligence. Built to stop emerging threats at machine
speed and give defenders the upper hand.

The AI-Native Cybersecurity Platform

## Built for Defenders.
## Engineered for Advantage.

Endpoint & Identity SecuritySecuring AICloud SecurityAutonomous SOCGlobal Services

Autonomously stop supply chain, ransomware, behavioral attacks, and credential misuse with AI-native
endpoint and identity protection unified in a single lightweight agent.

# Speak Freely

Say "hello" to a different messaging experience. An unexpected focus on privacy, combined with all
of the features you expect.


[ Get Signal ][75]

## Why use Signal?

Explore below to see why Signal is a simple, powerful, and secure messenger

## Share Without Insecurity

State-of-the-art end-to-end encryption (powered by the open source Signal Protocol) keeps your
conversations secure. We can't read your messages or listen to your calls, and no one else can
either. Privacy isn’t an optional mode — it’s just the way that Signal works. Every message, every
call, every time.

### Say Anything

Share text, voice messages, photos, videos, GIFs and files for free. Signal uses your phone's data
connection so you can avoid SMS and MMS fees.

### Speak Freely

Make crystal-clear voice and video calls to people who live across town, or across the ocean, with
no long-distance charges.

### Make Privacy Stick

Add a new layer of expression to your conversations with encrypted stickers. You can also create and
share your own sticker packs.

### Get Together with Groups

Group chats make it easy to stay connected to your family, friends, and coworkers.

## No ads. No trackers. No kidding.

There are no ads, no affiliate marketers, and no creepy tracking in Signal. So focus on sharing the
moments that matter with the people who matter to you.

## Free for Everyone

Signal is an independent nonprofit. We're not tied to any major tech companies, and we can never be
acquired by one either. Development is supported by grants and donations from people like you.

# Speak Freely

Say "hello" to a different messaging experience. An unexpected focus on privacy, combined with all
of the features you expect.


[ Get Signal ][75]

## Why use Signal?

Explore below to see why Signal is a simple, powerful, and secure messenger

## Share Without Insecurity

State-of-the-art end-to-end encryption (powered by the open source Signal Protocol) keeps your
conversations secure. We can't read your messages or listen to your calls, and no one else can
either. Privacy isn’t an optional mode — it’s just the way that Signal works. Every message, every
call, every time.

### Say Anything

Share text, voice messages, photos, videos, GIFs and files for free. Signal uses your phone's data
connection so you can avoid SMS and MMS fees.

### Speak Freely

Make crystal-clear voice and video calls to people who live across town, or across the ocean, with
no long-distance charges.

### Make Privacy Stick

Add a new layer of expression to your conversations with encrypted stickers. You can also create and
share your own sticker packs.

### Get Together with Groups

Group chats make it easy to stay connected to your family, friends, and coworkers.

## No ads. No trackers. No kidding.

There are no ads, no affiliate marketers, and no creepy tracking in Signal. So focus on sharing the
moments that matter with the people who matter to you.

## Free for Everyone

Signal is an independent nonprofit. We're not tied to any major tech companies, and we can never be
acquired by one either. Development is supported by grants and donations from people like you.

Absolutely! We are an SMS activation service that helps users maintain their privacy and avoid

For how long is the number issued?

Can the number be used again?

arrived within 5-10 minutes, just cancel the activation. Your money will be instantly returned to
your balance, and you can try a different number or a different country.
Are refunds available?
Absolutely! We have a simple rule: no code, no pay. If you buy a number but the SMS never arrives,
the system automatically refunds the money to your balance. You only pay for actual results.
Need larger volumes — what should I do?
We are always happy to work with wholesale customers! If you need "bulk and fast," just reach out to
our support team. We can offer you special pricing, a stable supply of numbers, and tailored terms.

For how long is the number issued?

Can the number be used again?

arrived within 5-10 minutes, just cancel the activation. Your money will be instantly returned to
your balance, and you can try a different number or a different country.
Are refunds available?

the system automatically refunds the money to your balance. You only pay for actual results.
Need larger volumes — what should I do?
We are always happy to work with wholesale customers! If you need "bulk and fast," just reach out to
our support team. We can offer you special pricing, a stable supply of numbers, and tailored terms.
